source.title: Anyone else not getting any extra materials from Dragonflight disenchanting crafted items?

quote: I also disenchanted around 600 Enchanted Writhebark Wand and never recived a reasonant crystal
notes: Original firsthand report dated 2024-11-10, after The War Within launch. 'Around 600' is an approximate completed-disenchant tally, NOT a verified exact denominator, so casts is null. The author explicitly reports no Resonant Crystal from any. Other possible enchanting material outputs were not enumerated; this does not mean zero total disenchant results. Author says 40 points in Draconic Disenchantment and 25 points in Dragon Isles Enchanting, but no profession skill, exact gear item version/bonus/ilevel, build, or 0-N output histogram. Enchanted Writhebark Wand identified as item 200641 from TSM https://tradeskillmaster.com/retail/us/items/200641 (recipe spell 391176); Resonant Crystal family identified as item 200113. TWW-era behavior may differ from Dragonflight-era and remains a historical/context-sensitive weak sample. Do not turn 'around 600' into exactly 600 casts, assume a current baseline zero chance, or treat absent extra-proc as individual-material rate.
specialization: 40 points Draconic Disenchantment; 25 points Dragon Isles Enchanting (per player)
